diagnosis: The route handler uses child_process.fork to spawn a background report generator worker, passing req.params.payrollRunId directly over IPC. The parent Express process performs no verification that the authenticated user belongs to the company associated with the payroll run, nor does it check for HR administrator permissions. An unauthorized user can generate and access salary reports of any enterprise on the platform.
